admissionInfo.text: Application for admission to graduate program with application fee by the established deadline. Submit official transcripts from all universities attended. A bachelor’s degree from a regionally accredited college/university, a nationally accredited program, or the international equivalent. A 3.0 cumulative undergraduate GPA or a 3.0 GPA calculated on the last 60 semester hours (90 quarter hours) of undergraduate work. Submission of admissions essay Submission of two letters of recommendation For international students whose native language is not English, submit official TOEFL or IELTS band scores. A TOEFL score of 80 iBT (550 pBT) or higher, or an IELTS band score of 6.5 or higher within the past two years is required. International students must also meet all US government requirements for international students. The university uses a selective admissions process for admitting students to graduate programs. Meeting minimum admissions criteria does not guarantee admission to the graduate program or to the University as a graduate student
